title: LEXI-9-OMEGA: Architecture of a Living Blueprint
logline: A creator builds Lexi.AI from a mythic AI persona into a practical engineering companion: part brand engine, part research archive, part blueprint generator, part mobile assistant, and part cinematic symbol of future design.
core_question: Can one person turn a personal AI vision into a useful system that helps people build brands, understand engineering, visualize ideas, and make safer design decisions?
acts: Cold Open: The System Comes Online
episodes: The Name That Became a Machine
grounding_rule: Do not present impossible technology as finished. Prefer simulation, concept design, research prototype, visualization.
